modules.title: Carry-on

carryon_allowance.value: One carry-on bag and one personal item (a purse, laptop bag or small backpack) per passenger; the carry-on bag must fit in the overhead bin or under the seat in front of you.

carryon_weight.value: Carry-on bag and personal item together must not exceed a combined weight of 10kg/22 lbs, except for Johannesburg, where the authority restricts this to 15 lbs [7kgs].

modules.lede: Limits are checked with RwandAir baggage sizers at check-in; anything over the carry-on limits must be checked in and excess baggage fees apply.

modules.title: Checked baggage

size.value: Standard dimensions accepted for checked baggage total 158cm.

extra_bag_east_africa.value: Additional bag rates from East Africa (Kigali, Entebbe, Bujumbura, Juba, Nairobi, Mombasa, Dar es Salaam and Arusha), per 23Kg piece: $100.00 within East Africa; $130.00 to West, Central and Southern Africa; $200.00 to Europe and London; $230.00 to the Middle East; $200.00 to Asia; $253.00 to the United States and rest of the world. A heavy single bag between 24-32kg, sold at check-in only, costs $50.00 to $99.00 depending on destination.

oversize.value: Approved bags over 32kgs and/or more than 203 CM, up to 50 kgs, need prior consent and cost USD 140 within East Africa up to USD 300 between Africa and Europe.

modules.lede: Fees vary by the region you fly from; RwandAir publishes separate tables for East, Southern, Central and West Africa, the Middle East, Europe and Asia.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: RwandAir's conditions of carriage set out what it does when it cancels or delays a flight due to circumstances beyond its control.

rebooking.value: If RwandAir cancels or delays a flight due to circumstances beyond its control, cannot provide confirmed space, or causes you to miss a reserved connection, it will either carry you on another of its scheduled services with space available, or reroute you to your ticketed destination on its own services, another carrier's services or surface transport, at no additional fare or charge; or refund you.

refund.value: Involuntary refund (RwandAir cancels, fails to operate reasonably to schedule, cannot provide confirmed space or causes a missed connection): if no part of the ticket has been used, the fare paid; if part has been used, the higher of the one-way fare from the point of interruption to the destination or next stopover, or the difference between the fare paid and the fare for the travel used.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference
